What "observed true" means (observation_checks.clj:52-70):
the file exists at the resolved commit (git show exits 0) AND decl-present? finds the :decl string at the start of some line, followed by whitespace, `:`, `(`, `{`, `[` or end of line.
Nothing else is read: not the rest of the file, not who wrote the line, not whether the line is correct.
